jobs.title: Product Designer (Mid-Level)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Hey there! Thanks for stopping by. We're Airtasker, the tech company that connects people who need to get things done with those who have the skills to do it. Our mission is to empower people to realise the full value of their skills. This doesn't just apply to those who use our product. It's also for our whole team of go-getters who bring the product to life and deliver impact to our community on a daily basis. Because we believe work (and life) is always better when you truly know and appreciate your strengths and skills.

We're looking for a mid-level Product Designer who's hands-on, AI-curious, and built for shipping. You'll join a cross-functional team to elevate the customer experience across our product, owning problem spaces from start to finish. Some days that means building the solution yourself to move fast and learn. Other days it means crafting considered designs for engineers to build when the work is more complex.

We move quickly, so this role suits someone who's resourceful inside real constraints, treats prototypes as the fastest way to learn, and is curious about using AI in both the product we ship and the way they work. You'll think holistically about the product (not just the design), form views on what we're shipping and why, and bring them to the table.

You'll have a support network of product designers, product managers, your design manager and engineers to help you grow in your craft and your career, delivering work you're genuinely proud of.

Join our team and help shape the future of Airtasker!

What you'll do:

  • Own problem spaces end-to-end. Coordinate with PMs, engineers and product marketing to define the work, then carry it from research through to shipped solutions.

  • Bring a product mindset. Care about what we're shipping and why, not just how it looks, and form views on roadmap, scope, success metrics and trade-offs.

  • Build, ship, learn. Get something tangible in front of real users early, whether a rough prototype or a thin slice of the live product, and let what you learn drive the next iteration.

  • Find creative solutions inside real constraints. Time, scope, resourcing and tech debt are part of the job, so find creative paths to deliver high-quality work at pace.

  • Look for AI opportunities in our product and your own work. Spot ways AI can help our users in their daily lives, and adopt AI in your own design process to ship faster and explore more.

  • Rapidly prototype with AI. Move from flows and wireframes through to high-fidelity designs and AI-built front-end prototypes. No coding background needed, just the curiosity to use AI to get there.

  • Develop and iterate on interfaces with the right level of craft, balancing pragmatism with quality.

  • Run user research and validate hypotheses to deeply understand problems and shape what comes next.

  • Apply and contribute to the Airtasker Design System, raising the bar with your own work and feeding improvements back where it makes sense.

  • Bring your work to the team for feedback, and use design reviews to land on the right solution and execution.

We'd love to hear from you if you tick some of these boxes:

  • Around 4-5 years of experience in product design.

  • A hands-on mindset and genuine interest in using AI, both in the product you ship and in how you work day-to-day.

  • Solid foundation in product design fundamentals, with a portfolio that shows growth in visual interface design.

  • Effective cross-functional collaboration with PMs, engineers, product marketing and others.

  • Comfortable shipping high-quality work inside real constraints.

  • Skilled in Figma and confident designing for iOS, Android and responsive web.

  • Skilled in qualitative research, from discovery and prototyping to testing and iteration.

  • Cares about outcomes, not just outputs, and forms views on the product, not just the design.

  • Familiarity with marketplace dynamics is helpful, but not required.

  • Open to giving and receiving constructive feedback in design reviews.

Our People Experience:

Our people team at Airtasker are dedicated to designing an industry leading people experience. This means creating an environment where you are empowered to do your best work and realise the full potential of your skills.Thriving

  • Hybrid working - when it comes to working, there’s no “one size fits all” approach, with Airtasker you choose the environment that helps you do your best work.

  • Airtime - welcome to no Slack and meeting-free Fridays! Airtime is designed so we regularly have dedicated focus time for work and personal growth.

  • Recharge days - each quarter we have a company-wide Recharge Day, equivalent to 4 additional days of leave per year. It’s a day for everyone when the world can wait and self-care takes centre stage.

  • Wellbeing support - our Employee Assistance Program provides confidential access for our people to GPs, dieticians, counselling and mental health specialists, providing essential support whenever needed.

  • Airpowerment Fund - we provide a $200 allowance to spend on anything that supports your health & wellbeing

Rewarding

  • Airtasker credits - it’s a great feeling to get things done. Even greater when you get $1000 worth of credits every year to help you check off your to-do list and connect with our community of Taskers.

  • Fair and equitable pay - this is a core commitment to our people. Every year we review industry data to ensure our compensation framework supports everyone to be recognised for the full value of their skills.

  • Tenure leave - To celebrate our people’s commitment to Airtasker, we offer tenure leave starting from your 3rd anniversary with the company. This begins with 3 extra days of leave per year, gradually increasing to a maximum of 5 days per year.

Belonging

  • DAREtasker - join our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion committee! Every month we meet to create meaningful and impactful programs of work that embrace belonging at Airtasker.

  • Celebration swap - not everyone celebrates the same things. That’s why, at Airtasker, you can swap national, state or territory public holidays for the ones that matter to you.

Growing

  • Learning and development - learning at Airtasker is on the job, guided by managers, enhanced by peers and led by ourselves. We deliver learning programs and budget allowances to invest in your growth.

  • 360 performance reviews - feedback is a gift. Every year we run 360 reviews across the business to recognise achievements and promote personal growth.

  • Volunteer leave - Our team members can take a day each year to lend a helping hand and support a cause they are passionate about.

Celebrating

  • Awards - and the winners are… our go-getters! Whether it’s our peer-nominated quarterly Values Awards or our periodic Go-Getter Spirit Award, we love celebrating our people and spreading good energy.

  • Vibe committee - good vibes only! Our Vibe Committee delivers events that hit the sweet spot of bringing us all together to enjoy each other’s company whether you’re local or remote.

  • Birthday leave - All of our people get an extra day of leave during their birthday week to take time away from work to celebrate.

At Airtasker we believe in culture add - that each person is different and has their own background, learnings and unique experiences that can add to the Airtasker cultural tapestry. We pride ourselves on our inclusive culture, and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

To all recruitment agencies and talent suppliers: Airtasker does not accept unsolicited resumes. Airtasker is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job postings or directly to our managers. If you are on our supplier list and have terms in place, ensure you work alongside our internal TA team and do not send resumes directly to managers.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Airtasker

Airtasker is Australia's leading platform connecting people who need work done with skilled people who want to do it. We make it easy for everyday Australians to get things done, from furniture assembly to full home renovations, while giving Taskers a flexible way to earn on their own terms.

We're a remote-friendly team based primarily in Sydney, building a platform that has facilitated millions of tasks and helped hundreds of thousands of Taskers grow their businesses.

About the role

Engineering at Airtasker is agentic: we work spec-first, directing autonomous systems that author code and curating the context that makes them effective. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who already builds this way: someone who can take a fascinating architectural problem, decompose it into agent-executable work, and deliver it to production standards. This isn't a role where AI experience is "a plus". Working this way is the job.

What you'll do

  • Deliver features through spec-driven, agentic workflows: write clear specs and acceptance criteria, then direct and verify agent-led implementation to production standards

  • Design agent workflows that solve recurring team problems, defining boundaries, escalation points and where humans stay in the loop

  • Curate the context that makes agents effective: repo maps, architecture summaries, decision logs and reusable task templates

  • Own delivery end-to-end: clarify requirements, do the technical research, engage stakeholders and clear blockages

  • Lead projects of business significance and engage in discussions about company strategy and goals

  • Partner with Product, Data and Design leaders on core product roadmap initiatives

  • Help hire and grow strong engineers through interviewing, guidance and mentorship

What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Fluency with AI coding tools (like Claude Code) across the full development lifecycle: exploration, implementation, refactoring, debugging, tests and docs

  • A spec-first mindset: you decompose work into agent-executable units with clear constraints and acceptance criteria

  • The root-cause habit: when AI output goes wrong, you stop and ask what was missing from the prompt, the context or the plan, and fix the upstream artifact, not just the symptom

  • Firm grounding in computer science and engineering fundamentals, with hands-on experience designing scalable architectures

  • Deep care for the product and commercial context your team operates in

  • A passion for teaching: you continually invest in your team members' growth and bring new technologies and practices to the team

Nice-to-have

  • Experience designing multi-step or multi-agent systems, including orchestration and human/agent handoffs

  • Experience instrumenting and evaluating AI workflows: evals, regression checks, reasoning about cost, latency and quality tradeoffs

  • Background in product engineering

  • Experience with marketplaces or two-sided platforms

Our People Experience:

Our people team at Airtasker are dedicated to designing an industry leading people experience. This means creating an environment where you are empowered to do your best work and realise the full potential of your skills.

Thriving

  • Hybrid working - when it comes to working, there’s no “one size fits all” approach, with Airtasker you choose the environment that helps you do your best work.

  • Airtime - welcome to no Slack and meeting-free Fridays! Airtime is designed so we regularly have dedicated focus time for work and personal growth.

  • Recharge days - each quarter we have a company-wide Recharge Day, equivalent to 4 additional days of leave per year. It’s a day for everyone when the world can wait and self-care takes centre stage.

  • Wellbeing support - our Employee Assistance Program provides confidential access for our people to GPs, dieticians, counselling and mental health specialists, providing essential support whenever needed.

  • Airpowerment Fund - we provide a $200 allowance to spend on anything that supports your health & wellbeing.


Rewarding

  • Airtasker credits - it’s a great feeling to get things done. Even greater when you get $1000 worth of credits every year to help you check off your to-do list and connect with our community of Taskers.

  • Fair and equitable pay - this is a core commitment to our people. Every year we review industry data to ensure our compensation framework supports everyone to be recognised for the full value of their skills.

  • Tenure leave - To celebrate our people’s commitment to Airtasker, we offer tenure leave starting from your 3rd anniversary with the company. This begins with 3 extra days of leave per year, gradually increasing to a maximum of 5 days per year.


Belonging

  • DAREtasker - join our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion committee! Every month we meet to create meaningful and impactful programs of work that embrace belonging at Airtasker.

  • Celebration swap - not everyone celebrates the same things. That’s why, at Airtasker, you can swap national, state or territory public holidays for the ones that matter to you.


Growing

  • Learning and development - learning at Airtasker is on the job, guided by managers, enhanced by peers and led by ourselves. We deliver learning programs and budget allowances to invest in your growth.

  • 360 performance reviews - feedback is a gift. Every year we run 360 reviews across the business to recognise achievements and promote personal growth.

  • Volunteer leave - Our team members can take a day each year to lend a helping hand and support a cause they are passionate about.


Celebrating

  • Awards - and the winners are… our go-getters! Whether it’s our peer-nominated quarterly Values Awards or our periodic Go-Getter Spirit Award, we love celebrating our people and spreading good energy.

  • Vibe committee - good vibes only! Our Vibe Committee delivers events that hit the sweet spot of bringing us all together to enjoy each other’s company whether you’re local or remote.

  • Birthday leave - All of our people get an extra day of leave during their birthday week to take time away from work to celebrate.


At Airtasker we believe in culture add - that each person is different and has their own background, learnings and unique experiences that can add to the Airtasker cultural tapestry. We pride ourselves on our inclusive culture, and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

To all recruitment agencies and talent suppliers: Airtasker does not accept unsolicited resumes. Airtasker is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job postings or directly to our managers. If you are on our supplier list and have terms in place, ensure you work alongside our internal TA team and do not send resumes directly to managers.

ABOUT AIRTASKER

Airtasker is Australia's leading platform connecting people who need work done with skilled people who want to do it. We make it easy for everyday Australians to get things done, from furniture assembly to full home renovations, while giving Taskers a flexible way to earn on their own terms.

We're a remote-friendly team based primarily in Sydney, building a platform that has facilitated millions of tasks and helped hundreds of thousands of Taskers grow their businesses.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Engineering at Airtasker is agentic: we work spec-first, directing autonomous systems that author code and curating the context that makes them effective. We're looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer who already builds this way and who knows native mobile inside out: someone who can take a fascinating architectural problem, decompose it into agent-executable work, and ship it to production standards across iOS and Android. This isn't a role where AI experience is "a plus". Working this way is the job.



This is a 12 month contract covering a parental leave.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Deliver mobile features through spec-driven, agentic workflows: write clear specs and acceptance criteria, then direct and verify agent-led implementation to production standards.

 - Design agent workflows that solve recurring team problems, defining boundaries, escalation points and where humans stay in the loop.

 - Curate the context that makes agents effective: repo maps, architecture summaries, decision logs and reusable task templates.

 - Own delivery end-to-end: clarify requirements, do the technical research, engage stakeholders and clear blockages.

 - Ship and maintain production apps across the full release cycle: store submission, phased rollout, and crash monitoring.

 - Partner with Product, Data and Design to deliver core mobile roadmap initiatives.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Must-have

 - Strong native iOS development in Swift and native Android development in Kotlin, with hands-on experience shipping and maintaining production apps on both platforms.

 - Solid grasp of mobile architecture and platform fundamentals: lifecycle, state and offline handling, performance and memory.

 - Fluency with AI coding tools (like Claude Code) across the full development lifecycle: exploration, implementation, refactoring, debugging, tests and docs.

 - A spec-first mindset: you decompose work into agent-executable units with clear constraints and acceptance criteria.

 - The root-cause habit: when AI output goes wrong, you stop and ask what was missing from the prompt, the context or the plan, and fix the upstream artifact, not just the symptom.

 - Deep care for the product and commercial context your team operates in.

Nice-to-have

 - React Native or other cross-platform experience, including native modules and bridging.

 - Mobile CI/CD experience: Fastlane, code signing, automated store deployment.

 - Experience designing multi-step or multi-agent systems, including orchestration and human/agent handoffs.

 - Experience instrumenting and evaluating AI workflows: evals, regression checks, reasoning about cost, latency and quality tradeoffs.

 - Experience with marketplaces or two-sided platforms.

About Airtasker

Airtasker is Australia's leading platform connecting people who need work done with skilled people who want to do it, from furniture assembly to full home renovations. We are a Sydney-based team building a platform that has facilitated millions of tasks and helped hundreds of thousands of Taskers grow their businesses.

 

About the role

Two things are happening at Airtasker at once. We are rebuilding the core of the platform, and we are changing how engineering works. This role leads the second one for product engineering.

You shape how the work gets done: how our Engineering Managers lead teams whose members each coordinate a fleet of agents, how engineers plan and review work they no longer type, and how much of our support and bug fixing we hand to agents outright. Your peer Directors lead our tooling and architecture, and you help steer that work from the CTO Leadership Team.

We are well on our way to being an AI-native engineering organisation. We work spec-first, directing autonomous systems that author code and curating the context that makes them effective, and that is how a growing share of the group works today.

The Evidence

 

In September 2025, Airtasker engineers merged ~11 pull requests per person per month. By August 2026, that number had risen to ~50 - a fourfold increase in a year.
In the first 27 days of August 2026 alone, the team merged 2,050 pull requests across 47 people.


Headcount did not change. This came from how we work rather than from hiring. Yes, it measures output, not value.

On the eight-level agentic maturity scale we use internally, we currently place ourselves at five to six. We are equally honest about where we have stalled. The remaining bottleneck is not model capability, it is us: how we plan, how we hand work to agents, and how much of our systems knowledge still lives only in people's heads.

The Group

Three teams covering acquisition, activation and retention. Around 21 people, five direct reports (three Engineering Managers and two senior engineers), split between Sydney and Hanoi. The teams are full-stack and own their verticals end to end, across backend, web and mobile.

This group is more than half of everyone who writes code at Airtasker. A small number of people carrying a large share of the company's output, which is roughly the point: we would rather have a leader who knows every engineer by name than another layer of management.

You will report to the CTO and sit on the CTO Leadership Team alongside the Director who leads our core marketplace platform, the Director who leads our operational teams across SRE and Data Platform, and the Director who leads decision science. Platform and architecture investment is decided at that table, which is where you make the case for what your teams need.

What you'll do

  • Work out what engineering management looks like in an agentic team. Coordinating work across people matters less now, and the quality of intent, context and review matters more. You would do that alongside three Engineering Managers who know our teams and our customers well, and feed what you learn back into how we grow and hire engineering leaders. There is no settled playbook for this anywhere yet, which is what makes it the largest part of the role and the hardest.

  • Change how engineers work with agents. We want one engineer directing a vertical slice end to end, running agents in parallel, with review happening at the plan rather than only at the diff. Getting there means new habits, and habits do not change because a director announced a new process.

  • Take support and bug fixing off humans. We think a large share of our triage and fixing can be handed to coding agents. Nobody here has proved it yet. You would lead that from hypothesis to production.

  • Partner with our product and design leaders on how we scope and sequence work. Agentic delivery breaks when intent is vague, and no amount of tooling fixes that upstream.

  • Bring rigour to how we measure engineering performance. Know where speed is converting into instability and review load rather than into shipped value, and show it with data. Self-reported productivity is not evidence, and we would like a leader who already knows why.

  • Question our metrics. We currently target 60 merged PRs per engineer per month and 90% of code generated by AI. Both are useful and both are gameable.

  • Represent product engineering on the CTO Leadership Team, and help set company technical direction.

  • Hire, and lift the bar through interviewing, guidance and mentorship.

What Hands-On Means Here

You are expected to be fluent enough with a coding agent to reason about our code, our architecture and our systems, and to build enough domain knowledge to join the on-call rotation alongside the other Directors. Shipping code into production is not part of the role, though nobody will stop you if that is what you enjoy.

  • You break work down into agent-executable units yourself, with clear constraints and acceptance criteria.

  • You can read a diff properly, and you recognise a well-framed piece of work because you have framed one yourself.

  • You treat being hands-on as the thing that earns you permission to change how everyone else works.

What a Good First Year Looks Like

In twelve months we would expect:

  • Our Engineering Managers running teams in a way that would have looked unrecognisable a year earlier.

  • Most non-trivial work planned, reviewed and merged through agent workflows, with our change failure rate holding.

  • A meaningful share of inbound bugs resolved without a human writing the fix.

If you got two of those three, we would consider it a good year.

What you'll bring

We care much more about what you have done than how long you have been doing it, so tell us about specific things you have built, fixed or changed rather than years of scope.

Must have

  • You have led a multi-team engineering group and grown engineering managers within it, and you can point to managers who got better while working for you.

  • You have taken an engineering organisation through a change that people resisted, and you can describe what you did about the resistance rather than what you announced.

  • You are hands-on with AI coding tools such as Claude Code across the full lifecycle. You think spec-first, and when agent output goes wrong you fix the upstream artefact rather than patching the symptom.

  • Strong engineering and architecture fundamentals, and the credibility to guide technical decisions without taking them over.

  • Based in Sydney, and able to be in the office around twice a week.

Nice to have

  • You have a point of view on how to run an engineering organisation well. We would welcome you challenging our thinking here.

  • You treat developer experience as a product, and can give us an example of using metrics to find hidden friction in the inner loop and what you changed to remove it.

  • Deep care for the product and commercial context, and a habit of coaching rather than directing.

  • Marketplaces or two-sided platforms.

  • Scaling delivery through better leverage rather than more headcount.

  • Working with teams split across time zones.

How We Hire

Four conversations and one short piece of written work. We aim to get you from application to decision in about two weeks, and we will tell you where you stand within two days of each stage.

  1. A conversation with our Talent Acquisition team. Motivation, the shape of the role, location and money, so nothing is a surprise later.

  2. A short written exercise. We send you a real Airtasker problem, lightly redacted, and ask for one to two pages: what you think is going on, and what you would do about it. Two pages is the limit, and telling us what you would do next with more time is part of the answer.

  3. A 90 minute conversation about what you wrote, with our CTO, an Engineering Director and one of our product leaders. We will dig into your reasoning, and part way through we will hand you something new and think about it together.

  4. A technical judgement conversation with two of our senior engineers, who would report to you. No coding, no whiteboard.

  5. A leadership and values conversation with our CTO and a People Partner.

Our people team at Airtasker are dedicated to designing an industry leading people experience. This means creating an environment where you are empowered to do your best work and realise the full potential of your skills.

  • Wellbeing support - our Employee Assistance Program provides confidential access for our people to GPs, dieticians, counselling and mental health specialists, providing essential support whenever needed.

  • Airpowerment Fund - we provide a $200 allowance to spend on anything that supports your health & wellbeing.


Rewarding

  • Airtasker credits - it’s a great feeling to get things done. Even greater when you get $1000 worth of credits every year to help you check off your to-do list and connect with our community of Taskers.

  • Fair and equitable pay - this is a core commitment to our people. Every year we review industry data to ensure our compensation framework supports everyone to be recognised for the full value of their skills.

  • Tenure leave - To celebrate our people’s commitment to Airtasker, we offer tenure leave starting from your 3rd anniversary with the company. This begins with 3 extra days of leave per year, gradually increasing to a maximum of 5 days per year.


Belonging

  • DAREtasker - join our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion committee! Every month we meet to create meaningful and impactful programs of work that embrace belonging at Airtasker.

  • Celebration swap - not everyone celebrates the same things. That’s why, at Airtasker, you can swap national, state or territory public holidays for the ones that matter to you.


Growing

  • Learning and development - learning at Airtasker is on the job, guided by managers, enhanced by peers and led by ourselves. We deliver learning programs and budget allowances to invest in your growth.

  • 360 performance reviews - feedback is a gift. Every year we run 360 reviews across the business to recognise achievements and promote personal growth.

Celebrating

  • Awards - and the winners are… our go-getters! Whether it’s our peer-nominated quarterly Values Awards or our periodic Go-Getter Spirit Award, we love celebrating our people and spreading good energy.

  • Vibe committee - good vibes only! Our Vibe Committee delivers events that hit the sweet spot of bringing us all together to enjoy each other’s company whether you’re local or remote.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Hey there! Thanks for stopping by. We’re Airtasker, the tech company that connects people who need to get things done with those who have the skills to do it.

Our mission is to empower people to realise the full value of their skills. This doesn’t just apply to those who use our product. It’s also for our whole team of go-getters who bring the product to life and deliver impact to our community on a daily basis. Because we believe work (and life) is always better when you truly know and appreciate your strengths and skills.

This role owns the execution of acquisition, retention and loyalty campaigns for Airtasker's fastest-growing products (Memberships and Rebooking) across every region we serve, plus usage of our core product. You'll report to the CRM & Product Marketing Lead and sit at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience, always with an eye on what actually moves Customers and Taskers.

 

What you'll do:

  • Build and launch campaigns in Braze, including in-app messages, emails, banners, push and SMS, in support of Rebooking, Memberships, Airflare and Growth

  • Help run our loyalty program, from giveaways and merch drops to referrals, to keep Members engaged

  • Support Tasker education: scheduling and hosting webinars like onboarding sessions and product Fireside Chats, tracking how they perform and iterating on content

  • Plan and run community touchpoints like merch mailouts, Tasker trophies and business cards, including the logistics and vendor management behind them

  • Report on campaign and experiment performance against KPIs for Rebooking and Memberships

 

We'd love to hear from you if you tick some of these boxes:

  • A track record in Product or Product Marketing, having helped bring products to market

  • Experience with loyalty programs is a strong plus

  • Time in a two-sided marketplace or with membership/subscription products is a bonus, not a requirement

  • Enough comfort with HTML/CSS to know where a change needs to happen, or confidence using AI tools like Claude, Gemini or ChatGPT to get there

  • Experience with Braze or a similar CRM platform, or the aptitude to pick one up fast

  • Strong written and verbal communication

  • A track record of working well across product, support, design, marketing, data and legal

  • Solid project management instincts and a knack for prioritising what matters

  • Comfort building experiments, iterating, and presenting what the data shows

  • The ability to turn a complex idea into a clear slide deck, infographic or webinar

What makes you a fit:

  • Proactive and hungry to learn, with a can-do attitude

  • You'd rather make progress and learn than wait for perfect

  • Comfortable moving fast through ambiguity

  • Analytical, experiment-minded, and commercially sharp

 

Our People Experience:

Our people team at Airtasker are dedicated to designing an industry leading people experience. This means creating an environment where you are empowered to do your best work and realise the full potential of your skills.

Thriving

  • Hybrid working - when it comes to working, there’s no “one size fits all” approach, with Airtasker you choose the environment that helps you do your best work.

  • Airtime - welcome to no Slack and meeting-free Fridays! Airtime is designed so we regularly have dedicated focus time for work and personal growth.

  • Recharge days - each quarter we have a company-wide Recharge Day, equivalent to 4 additional days of leave per year. It’s a day for everyone when the world can wait and self-care takes centre stage.

  • Wellbeing support - our Employee Assistance Program provides confidential access for our people to GPs, dieticians, counselling and mental health specialists, providing essential support whenever needed.

  • Airpowerment Fund - we provide a $200 allowance to spend on anything that supports your health & wellbeing.


Rewarding

  • Airtasker credits - it’s a great feeling to get things done. Even greater when you get $1000 worth of credits every year to help you check off your to-do list and connect with our community of Taskers.

  • Fair and equitable pay - this is a core commitment to our people. Every year we review industry data to ensure our compensation framework supports everyone to be recognised for the full value of their skills.

  • Tenure leave - To celebrate our people’s commitment to Airtasker, we offer tenure leave starting from your 3rd anniversary with the company. This begins with 3 extra days of leave per year, gradually increasing to a maximum of 5 days per year.


Belonging

  • DAREtasker - join our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion committee! Every month we meet to create meaningful and impactful programs of work that embrace belonging at Airtasker.

  • Celebration swap - not everyone celebrates the same things. That’s why, at Airtasker, you can swap national, state or territory public holidays for the ones that matter to you.


Growing

  • Learning and development - learning at Airtasker is on the job, guided by managers, enhanced by peers and led by ourselves. We deliver learning programs and budget allowances to invest in your growth.

  • 360 performance reviews - feedback is a gift. Every year we run 360 reviews across the business to recognise achievements and promote personal growth.

  • Volunteer leave - Our team members can take a day each year to lend a helping hand and support a cause they are passionate about.


Celebrating

  • Awards - and the winners are… our go-getters! Whether it’s our peer-nominated quarterly Values Awards or our periodic Go-Getter Spirit Award, we love celebrating our people and spreading good energy.

  • Vibe committee - good vibes only! Our Vibe Committee delivers events that hit the sweet spot of bringing us all together to enjoy each other’s company whether you’re local or remote.

  • Birthday leave - All of our people get an extra day of leave during their birthday week to take time away from work to celebrate.


At Airtasker we believe in culture add - that each person is different and has their own background, learnings and unique experiences that can add to the Airtasker cultural tapestry. We pride ourselves on our inclusive culture, and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

To all recruitment agencies and talent suppliers: Airtasker does not accept unsolicited resumes. Airtasker is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job postings or directly to our managers. If you are on our supplier list and have terms in place, ensure you work alongside our internal TA team and do not send resumes directly to managers.
